title: Design, synthesis, and anti-inflammatory evaluation of new isatin azo disperse dyes: computational studies, molecular docking, and printing performance on polyester fabrics
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23257-23279
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01392A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hend A. Hekal, Elkhabiry Shaban, Zeinab A. Elshahid, Hayam A. Abd El Salam, Faten M. Atlam, Ahmed A. Nosier
Novel isatin azo dyes were synthesized and characterized. They showed excellent textile properties and notable anti-inflammatory activity. DFT and docking identified 5b as the most potent candidate with strong protein interactions.
